meta.title: Deterministic release-proof handoff and forward-only recovery for deployment-controller issue #93
meta.author: Codex release planner

feature.problem_statement: PR #100 landed the release handoff on main d3565f534b2f64585c3e15e35d8d645449f4f09, but Automatic Release 32798160604 selected the immutable unpublished v0.6.13/ad52df candidate, Release Verify 32798188729 succeeded, and the handoff failed because GitHub persisted details_url as canonical /runs/<check-id>. The implementation also omits filter=all for historical checks and treats unrelated same-name checks as candidates, so valid ancestry-bound proof can be hidden or poisoned.
goals: Make release-proof selection exact, deterministic, ancestry-bound, and compatible with GitHub's persisted check URL.
Retire unpublished v0.6.13 and allocate only forward v0.6.14 after repaired code reaches protected main.
Make coordinator, verifier, and publisher retries idempotent and fail closed with least-privilege permissions.
non_goals: Recover, resume, dispatch, retag, move, delete, or publish v0.6.13.
Signed authorization, manifest-v3, public-asset closure, or other unimplemented architecture from v1.6.
Changing PR #100's unrelated behavior or PR #97's separate v0.6.8 recovery path.
scope_in: Current main d3565f5 release surfaces: .github/workflows/automatic-release.yaml, .github/workflows/release.yaml, .github/workflows/publish-release.yaml, hack/release-plan.py, hack/release-coordinator-policy.js, hack/release-handoff-policy.js, their focused tests, and docs/releasing.md.
Exact external_id/details_url handoff identity, filter=all pagination, historical proof selection, forward-only version guards, permissions, and retry/crash semantics.
Protected checks test, lint, chart, integration, and supply-chain plus post-merge live acceptance.
scope_out: GitHub, repository, workflow, tag, release, package, cluster, or deployment mutation during specification work.
Runtime use of administrator-ruleset-evidence-v2.json or any evidence sidecar.

requirements.statement: Base implementation and review on exact current main d3565f534b2f64585c3e15e35d8d645449f4f09, reconcile the six PR #100 files, and preserve unrelated PR #97 recovery files.
requirements.rationale: Release proof behavior changed in PR #100 and stale ancestry invalidates the prior draft.

requirements.statement: Construct one canonical handoff identity containing repository, source, tag, CI/coordinator/verifier IDs and attempts, coordinator check ID, and publisher revision; derive external_id deterministically from it.
requirements.rationale: A tuple is the authority for retries and prevents cross-run proof reuse.

requirements.statement: When validating a persisted handoff, require exact external_id, app slug, name, source head SHA, completed/success state, and accept GitHub's canonical details_url /<owner>/<repo>/runs/<check-id>; do not require the requested workflow-attempt URL.
requirements.rationale: Live check 97655710504 proves GitHub canonicalizes details_url.

requirements.statement: Filter handoff candidates by exact external_id before any name check; ignore unrelated same-name checks and fail only when more than one exact tuple exists.
requirements.rationale: A prior tuple must not poison a fresh retry, while duplicate exact tuples are ambiguous.

requirements.statement: Paginate every historical coordinator/proof check query with filter=all and deterministically inspect exact external_id candidates newest-to-oldest, skipping failed, incomplete, unrelated, malformed, or non-success checks.
requirements.rationale: Default GitHub pagination hides older valid checks and newest same-name failures.

requirements.statement: Accept historical proof only when its exact completed-success coordinator run, CI identity, repository, tag, source SHA, and coordinator-to-protected-main ancestry all validate; never correlate by run-list time or recency alone.
requirements.rationale: Historical proof is safe only when identities and ancestry agree.

requirements.statement: Treat immutable unpublished v0.6.13/ad52dfcbc45d71eccad1d49fbd905161af7a44b1 as retired: release-plan.py and all coordinator/verifier/publisher entry points must reject resume, no-op, and dispatch for it.
requirements.rationale: The old tag cannot contain the repair and the observed run made no publication writes.

requirements.statement: After the repaired change merges through protected main, allocate v0.6.14 at that exact forward source and require exact source/tag equality at every handoff stage.
requirements.rationale: Forward-only allocation is the safe recovery path.

requirements.statement: Release Verify must dispatch and authenticate only the exact tag/source/run attempt, and its authorization path must use least privilege: contents:read, actions:write, and id-token:write only where required.
requirements.rationale: Verifier identity must not be substituted by a similarly named run or broader token.

requirements.statement: Publish Release must remain workflow_dispatch-only, revalidate all exact proof identities immediately before each write, and use only actions:read, contents:write, and id-token:write plus existing narrow registry credentials.
requirements.rationale: Publication authority belongs to the protected publisher and must fail closed on drift.

requirements.statement: Forbid workflow_run handoff publication, pull_request_target, checks:write handoff creation, Administration/PAT/App tokens, manual old-tag bypass, and candidate-source checkout or execution in the publisher trust boundary.
requirements.rationale: These authorities and inputs would reintroduce the confused-deputy failure.

requirements.statement: Retries must reuse an exact settled handoff and exact release identity; concurrent or repeated attempts must fail on exact duplicates or continue only after byte/identity equality, never create a second tuple or dispatch a different source.
requirements.rationale: GitHub lacks a general CAS and retries must be create-only and idempotent.

requirements.statement: Classify crashes and ambiguous API responses as unknown/manual reconciliation, preserve existing immutable state, and prohibit delete, replace, overwrite, tag move, release move, rollback, or fabricated success evidence.
requirements.rationale: No read-after-write ambiguity can authorize destructive recovery.

requirements.statement: Keep planner and policy helpers side-effect free except declared GitHub operations, use bounded polling of the directly returned verifier run/attempt, and never select proof using workflow-run-list time correlation.
requirements.rationale: Deterministic bounded reads reduce race and stale-list behavior.

requirements.statement: Update the exact implementation and test surfaces: automatic-release.yaml, release.yaml, publish-release.yaml, release-plan.py, release-coordinator-policy.js, release-handoff-policy.js, test-release-plan.py, test-release-coordinator-policy.js, test-release-handoff-policy.js, test-release-graph.py, and docs/releasing.md.
requirements.rationale: The defect and its contract span the coordinator, verifier, publisher boundary, six landed release files, and documented tests.

requirements.statement: Wire hermetic credential-free tests and action/policy checks into existing protected checks test, lint, chart, integration, and supply-chain without weakening 40-character action pins or least-privilege permissions.
requirements.rationale: The fix must be reviewable before any release write.

requirements.statement: Do not claim acceptance until live post-merge evidence observes protected checks, forward v0.6.14 authorization and Release Verify success, exact handoff persistence, and successful Publish Release; absence of any publication write remains a failure, not a GO.
requirements.rationale: The observed #100 run stopped before publisher dispatch and cannot prove recovery.

requirements.statement: Sequence issue-linked PR #99 before PR #94, and merge or resume #94 only after verified v0.6.14; never use #94 to trigger another v0.6.13 release attempt.
requirements.rationale: The follow-up recovery change must not create a second unpublished tag.

requirements.statement: Record administrator-ruleset-evidence-v2 only as external review evidence at /home/rickebo/.codex/pipeline/runs/2026-08-24T16-21-43-985Z/administrator-ruleset-evidence-v2.json, length 4024, SHA-256 55dbee3772ce06d0af59df8cb21d6862d4d167470065e2580ff9adb3d28efb58, captured at main d3565f; runtime workflows, tests, helpers, and policies must not read or use it.
requirements.rationale: Ruleset visibility is an administrator prerequisite, not a runtime authorization input.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given current main is d3565f534b2f64585c3e15e35d8d645449f4f09, when the implementation plan is reviewed, then all six PR #100 surfaces and preserved PR #97 files are explicitly reconciled.

Given checks contain unrelated same-name rows, one exact row with canonical /runs/<check-id>, and an exact duplicate, when handoff selection runs, then unrelated rows are ignored, the canonical exact row is accepted, and duplicate exact rows fail.

Given paginated history contains failed newest, unrelated, malformed, and older valid checks, when proof selection runs with filter=all, then it deterministically selects only exact completed-success ancestry-bound evidence without time correlation.
Given the only reachable base is retired v0.6.13, when planner and coordinator run, then they never resume/no-op/dispatch it and allocate only forward v0.6.14 at repaired protected main.

Given verifier or publisher input has mismatched identity, event, ref, permission, or source, when validation runs, then it fails before mutation and rejects workflow_run, manual old-tag, and broad-token paths.

Given a retry or crash occurs before or after a check/release write, when the operation is retried, then exact settled state is reused, ambiguous state is manual-only, and no destructive or duplicate mutation occurs.

Given a proposed implementation change, when protected CI runs, then named policy tests, YAML/action checks, chart checks, integration checks, and supply-chain checks execute with unchanged required names and immutable pins.

Given the issue #93 corrective PR is merged, when protected post-merge release evidence is inspected, then no success is claimed until exact v0.6.14 verifier, handoff, publisher, and public release evidence exists.
Given PR #94 is ready, when sequencing is evaluated, then it remains blocked until verified v0.6.14 and cannot trigger a v0.6.13 attempt.

Given administrator evidence v2 exists at the stated path, length, and SHA, when runtime-input scanning runs, then it records the bundle as external review-only and proves no runtime file read or import.

test_plan.approach: Extend hack/test-release-handoff-policy.js with canonical persisted details_url, exact external_id filtering, unrelated same-name ignore, exact duplicate rejection, and exact tuple retry fixtures.

Extend hack/test-release-coordinator-policy.js and hack/test-release-handoff-policy.js with paginated filter=all pages, failed/newest skipping, malformed/unrelated rejection, deterministic ordering, and ancestry API fixtures.
Extend hack/test-release-plan.py with retired v0.6.13 resume/no-op/dispatch rejection and forward v0.6.14 allocation at an exact source.

Parse .github/workflows/automatic-release.yaml, release.yaml, and publish-release.yaml to assert event/ref/source identity, permissions, forbidden authorities, and no candidate-source publisher execution.
Drive fake check/release APIs through retries, races, 422s, timeout, killed requests, and unknown read-after-write states; assert exact reuse, manual reconciliation, and zero delete/move/overwrite.
Run hack/test-release-graph.py and static helper-closure checks over the six release files, proving bounded direct-run polling and no run-list time correlation.

Run named release planner/coordinator/handoff/graph suites, YAML/action pin validation, and existing test, lint, chart, integration, and supply-chain wiring; fail on omitted test IDs or weakened permissions.
Review issue-linked PR ordering and exact current-main ancestry; verify PR #99 precedes PR #94 and no PR #94 path resumes v0.6.13.

After the issue #93 corrective PR merges, inspect protected check names and exact run/check IDs, verifier success, canonical handoff persistence, publisher dispatch, release/tag/package/assets, and forward v0.6.14 identity.

Recompute v2 evidence byte length and SHA from the stated file, record it as review-only, and scan runtime source/workflows/tests to prove the path and sidecars are not inputs; this spec makes no GO claim.

perspectives.summary: The minimal plan is implementable on exact d3565f: fix check identity/history and retire v0.6.13 before forward v0.6.14; no runtime signed-manifest design is needed.
Require exact external_id first, canonical persisted details_url, filter=all, ancestry-bound completed-success proof, least privilege, immutable writes, and external-only administrator evidence.

Require focused hermetic policy/workflow tests, protected five-check wiring, deterministic retry/crash fixtures, and credentialed live v0.6.14 acceptance; the stale draft and current failed handoff are not acceptance evidence.
